$comment: Site-specific Take 5 reporting rules for project 10265 (WASP WH Bulk Earthworks). Transcribed from the Email Report sheet of 'Decmil Take 5 and KPI register.xlsm' (columns U, V, W, X and Stats!B3) on 10 Nov 2026. Matching is case-insensitive substring, as in the workbook. Edit these lists, not the code.

notRequired.$comment: A person is NOT REQUIRED to complete a Take 5 if their role contains any roleKeywords entry, or their role or crew contains any roleOrCrewKeywords entry. They stay on the list, marked Not required, and are excluded from every count.

optional.$comment: Optional (manual-entry) people are counted only on days they have Take 5s; at zero they are excluded with status Optional and never appear in the 'did not do' list. Matched on name or role. This rule is applied BEFORE notRequired, so a surveyor in a Site Office crew is Optional rather than Not required.

groups.$comment: Required people are split into two reporting groups for the management email (Email Report P5). A person is Maintenance if their crew starts with any maintenanceCrewPrefixes entry (the workbook tests LEFT(crew,5)="Maint") or their role contains any maintenanceRoleKeywords entry; everyone else required is Operations.

email.$comment: Shape of the daily management email, as produced by Email Report!A1, A3 and A4:D8.
email.sentence: The {zeroCount} people who didn't do take 5s are {zeroNames}
email.intro: Please see below the Take 5's stats for {weekday} {date}:
